## Key ideas {#dc1-key-ideas .dc-lesson}

<div class="dc-key-grid">
<div><h3>Base <span data-math="e"></span></h3><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}e^{f(x)}=f'(x)e^{f(x)}"></span></div>
<div><h3>Any positive constant base</h3><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}a^{f(x)}=f'(x)(\ln a)a^{f(x)}"></span></div>
</div>
<p class="takeaway">Identify the base, differentiate the exponent, and check whether the whole expression is a product or quotient.</p>
<p><strong>I can</strong> select and apply the appropriate differentiation rules to an exponential function.</p>
<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 7 · Key Ideas</p>

::: notes
Invite students to explain the role of each factor rather than memorise a string of symbols. Ask a student to contrast Example 1.6(b), Example 1.7(a) and Example 1.7(b). Evidence of success: identifies the expression's structure, keeps the original exponential factor and includes all necessary derivative factors. Record concise key ideas in the booklet. About one minute.
:::
